title: ReBar support for 20gb RTX 3080?
body:
Has anyone successfully patched the drivers of a modded RTX 3080 20gb to get Rebar support? I already updated my 3090.

Rebar is required for P2P which would give me roughly +10-15% inference speeds, at least for vLLM. Anyways, I'm fairly certain P2P isn't possible for this card. A mixed GPU setup certainly doesn't help either.

I'm curious to hear what others have done. I might stick to pipeline parallelization with MTP in llama.cpp. I get about 50 t/s with that

Any input is welcome!! Feel free to correct me if I'm wrong on anything

submitted by /u/ILoveToyota37
